children: Genesco reported second-quarter fiscal 2027 results with net sales of $529.9 million and GAAP diluted EPS of $0.32. Reported gross margin was 51.4% (includes $21.8 million tariff refund) and GAAP operating income was $3.6 million. The company raised its full-year adjusted diluted EPS outlook to the high end of a $2.00–$2.40 range.
Net sales: $529.9 million for Q2 fiscal 2027 (down 3% vs. Q2 FY26).
Gross margin: 51.4% for Q2 (includes $21.8 million tariff refund); adjusted gross margin 47.2% (up 140 bps vs. prior year).
Operating income (GAAP): $3.6 million (0.7% of sales); adjusted operating loss of $8.3 million (−1.6% of sales).
Net earnings (GAAP): $3.48 million for the quarter; diluted GAAP EPS $0.32. Adjusted loss from continuing operations: $(8.8) million, or $(0.83) per share.
Balance sheet & liquidity: Cash $57.1 million and total debt $15.8 million as of Aug. 1, 2026; inventories $539.7 million (up 8% YoY).
Comparable sales: Total comparable sales declined 1% in Q2; same-store sales were up 1% while e-commerce comps declined 6%.
Brand performance: Journeys comparable sales +2% (eighth consecutive quarter of positive total comps for Journeys); Johnston & Murphy comps +4%; Schuh comps −9%.
Operational actions: Company closed 25 stores in the quarter and opened three, ending the quarter with 1,186 stores (down ~5% YoY) and square footage down 5%.

Tariff-related outcome: Received $22.5 million in tariff refunds (including interest) in Q2 related to branded businesses; these refunds are excluded from adjusted results and not assumed in full-year guidance.

Cost program and capital activity: Announced cost savings program targeting $40–$50 million through FY2029 (up to $20 million this year); Q2 capex $17 million primarily for store remodels; company repurchased 317,503 shares in the subsequent quarter through Aug. 31, 2026.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
